''See also: [[hunger madra Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Hunger [[madra]] is a specialized and volatile form of energy characterized by an insatiable, predatory nature. While some believe it to be a corruption of [[pure madra]], it is fundamentally linked to the [[Dreadgods]], who possess an eternal [[hunger]] that serves as a core component of their existence. This energy is capable of devouring almost anything, including physical matter, spiritual strength, and various forms of [[madra]]. Beyond simple consumption, it is deeply textured with complex emotional and psychological drives such as greed, ambition, gluttony, and lust. In practical application, [[hunger]] [[madra]] can be utilized through specialized techniques or integrated into objects and limbs as [[binding|bindings]]. These [[binding|bindings]], such as those found in [[Remnants]] or used to create specialized arms, can act as parasitic tools that siphon energy from others. However, this power is extremely dangerous to the user; it can be difficult to control and may bleed into the user's own psyche, threatening their sense of self. Despite these risks, it is a potent force used in various [[Paths]], such as the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]], and has been known to facilitate rapid [[advancement]] for those who can harness its capacity to consume and integrate the power of their prey.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Hunger [[madra]] is a specific type of [[madra]] that can manifest as gaunt, transparent figures or skeletal spirits composed of gray-white energy. While [[Northstrider]] has utilized [[hunger]] [[madra]] techniques, the substance is considered perhaps the most dangerous aspect to its own user. [[Lindon]] sought knowledge regarding this [[madra]] from the [[Monarch]] and eventually purchased a shipment of it under the [[Akura clan|Akura family]] name. This substance has been used to warp animals into an army of [[dreadbeasts]], and it serves as a component in both [[Dreadgod cults]] and the [[madra]] of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]].}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Hunger [[madra]] is a power associated with [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] that functions as a network woven throughout the area. Introduced after the [[Arelius founder]], this substance can be used to create [[hungry ghouls|ghouls]] or utilized in traps by [[Subject One]], who may be the first host or the source of the power. Within [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], gray-[[white hunger madra]] can emerge from [[stone]] to grab ankles, shoot out of tunnels in webs, or coalesce in hallways. The domain of this [[madra]] constantly [[chips]] away at those inside and gnaws at [[Lindon]]'s own [[madra]], though it is difficult to sense. While the power offers endless strength, it also curses the [[Silent King]] and causes [[hungry ghouls|ghouls]] to claw up from the ground as attacks grow more frequent.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Hunger [[madra]] manifests in various forms, including the degradation experienced by [[Akura Malice]] within a [[labyrinth]] and its presence within [[Reigan Shen]]. A spear composed of pure [[white hunger madra]] was discovered by [[Lindon]], though [[Yerin]] has notably neglected her own supply of the energy. The power is deeply connected to the [[Silent King]], who possesses a limb of potent [[hunger]] [[madra]] and causes all [[hunger]] [[madra]] in the world to tremble when he roars. During the [[Dreadgod]]'s ripple, a sympathetic [[resonance]] was sought with the [[madra]] as a red [[dragon]] trailed [[blood]] and [[hunger]] [[madra]] in its wake. Ultimately, this energy proved destructive when it devoured [[Lindon's Remnant arm|Lindon's right arm]] from the elbow to the shoulder.}}
